text:
anna_ml: Heads-up — after the q5 quant bring-up on calypso-v2 I’m seeing consistent BLEU regressions on zh->en devset. Quick diff shows extra spaces inserted between CJK chars and embedded latin (pinyin/latin tokens).
liwei: can you paste a minimal failing example?
anna_ml: sure. baseline (float32):
```
ref: 我叫zhangsan，今天去上班。
hyp: 我叫zhangsan，今天去上班。
```
quant q5: 
```
hyp: 我叫 zhangsan ，今天去上班 。
```
note the inserted spaces around `zhangsan` and punctuation. BLEU drops ~1.8 points on our subset.
jeorge_prod: any tokenizer change in the onboard config? model code?
anna_ml: not in the tokenizer. We used the same sentencepiece graph. The runtime kernel selection changed (new qconv kernel) and the kvcache packing path touched the detokenize step for mixed-script prefix handling.
eva_eval: I ran eval harness with token-level diff: majority are single-space insertions around [A-Za-z0-9]+ runs. Quick stats: 2.1% of sentences affected, avg BLEU -1.7. Repo: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/eng-ml/builds/CalypsoQ5/7821 (logs attached).
liwei: can you repro locally with python snippet?
anna_ml: yes:
```
# reproduce
from redwood_tokenizer import SentencePieceDetok
sp = SentencePieceDetok('calypso-v2-sp.model')
print(sp.detokenize('我 叫 zhangsan ， 今天'))
```
If we call the detok path used in q5 runtime it outputs with spaces. If we call the reference detok it does not.
mira_infra: deploy-bot shows the runtime rollout touched the mixed-script normalization flag (normalize_interstitial_spaces=true) in the distro. That feature was intended for some RTL fixes but probably overzealous.
jorge_prod: ok — plan: 1) revert flag on canary nodes and re-run evals 2) add unit test for CJK+Latin sequences 3) bisect kernel change if needed. Who can run the canary?
anna_ml: I can flip the flag on canary tonight and run the eval harness. If it fixes, we keep flag off and schedule a proper fix for a whitelist approach.
eva_eval: please also add a regression test under eng-ml/evals/locale/regressions with the sample above. I’ll add the BLEU assertion.
mira_infra: canary job queued: <https://ci.redwood.ai/canary/6171717200> (deploy-bot: started deploy to calypso-q5-canary).
deploy-bot: Deployment started for calypso-q5-canary by mira_infra — job 6171717200 — rolling 3 nodes.
liwei: if canary still shows spaces, next step is kernel bisect: cc @anna_ml @mira_infra. We should capture raw tok ids before/after quant kernel path.
anna_ml: noted. I’ll dump token ids + detok path traces and ping the thread. For trace: use `RUNTIME_TRACE=1` and `SP_DETOK_DEBUG=1`.
jorge_prod: thanks — also scope for a short-term postprocess: collapse `CJK + space + latin` -> `CJK+latin` in detok if canary proves noisy. But prefer runtime fix.
eva_eval: scheduling a quick smoke diff now. ETA ~45m. I’ll post results here.
anna_ml: thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. :heart:
